headline: Elsewedy Electric in Talks With Iraq on Industrial City and EV Projects
summary: Iraq's National Investment Commission held talks with Egyptian firm Elsewedy Electric on strategic investment projects. Proposed developments include an integrated industrial city, a university campus, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
why: Elsewedy Electric is a leading Egyptian multinational electrical equipment and infrastructure manufacturer. Cross-border industrial developments expand manufacturing capacity and power grid infrastructure across the Middle East.
